caption: the moon enters sagittarius today, 10:52 utc. tomorrow it hits last quarter there.

slides.headline: the moon's in *sagittarius*: say it straight, today
the *moon* moves into the honest sign
slides.body: it reaches last quarter tomorrow. astrologers read a sagittarius moon as blunt and restless. mercury's still retrograde, so blunt, but kind.

slides.headline: the first thing you say should be *true*, not cute.
